notes.title: Magnetic Structures 1.4 - New Update Release!
notes.content:
[h3]We're excited to announce a major update for Magnetic Structures 1.4! Explore four brand new levels filled with unique challenges and enhanced gameplay mechanics. Dive back into the world of magnetic puzzles and discover what awaits you![/h3]

[b]Update Highlights:[/b]

[b]Four New Levels:[/b] Each level introduces new mechanics and obstacles that will test your skills like never before.
[b]Gameplay Enhancements:[/b] Enjoy refined mechanics and improved visuals that elevate your gaming experience.
[b]Unlock New Achievements:[/b] Take on new objectives and earn exclusive rewards for your achievements in the game.
Join the Adventure: Update your game now and experience the latest content! We can't wait to see how you navigate the new levels and solve the challenges within.

Thank You for Your Support! Your feedback and support mean the world to us. Stay tuned for more updates and keep enjoying Magnetic Structures 1.4!

Thank you for your continued support and we can't wait to hear your thoughts on the new update!

Magnetic Structures Team
